description: Monday-through-Sunday activity, hydration, energy, and workout details for the selected week.

panels.description: Sum of detailed daily step records, using workout-recorded steps as a fallback when an all-day record is unavailable. Known multi-day rollups are excluded.

targets.rawSql: WITH health_steps AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 day',time,'$timezone') AS day,sum(value) AS steps FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='step_count' AND resolution='raw' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') GROUP BY 1),workout_steps AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 day',s.time,'$timezone') AS day,sum(s.value) AS steps FROM workout_samples s JOIN workouts w ON w.id=s.workout_id WHERE w.user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND s.metric='step_count' AND s.time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND s.time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(coalesce(sum(coalesce(h.steps,w.steps)),0))::bigint AS value FROM health_steps h FULL JOIN workout_steps w USING(day);

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='walking_running_distance' AND resolution='raw' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days');

SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='active_energy' AND resolution='raw' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days');

SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='apple_exercise_time' AND resolution='raw' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days');

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM workouts WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND start_time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND start_time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days');

SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM end_time-start_time)))/60,0) AS value FROM workouts WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND start_time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND start_time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days');

panels.description: Detailed all-day steps are used when available. Missing days fall back to workout-recorded steps, which can undercount activity outside workouts. The dashed line marks the 10,500-step daily goal; multi-day rollups are excluded.

targets.rawSql: WITH health_steps AS (SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 day',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS day,sum(value) AS steps FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='step_count' AND resolution='raw' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') GROUP BY 1),workout_steps AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 day',s.time,'$timezone') AS day,sum(s.value) AS steps FROM workout_samples s JOIN workouts w ON w.id=s.workout_id WHERE w.user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND s.metric='step_count' AND s.time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND s.time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') GROUP BY 1),daily AS (SELECT h.day,coalesce(h.steps,w.steps) AS steps FROM health_steps h LEFT JOIN workout_steps w USING(day)) SELECT day AS time,steps AS "Daily steps",avg(steps) OVER () AS "Daily average",10500.0 AS "10,500 step goal" FROM daily ORDER BY day;

panels.title: Daily steps

panels.description: Daily-resolution records only; known multi-day summary records are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 day',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS time,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='active_energy') AS "Active kcal",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='basal_energy_burned') AS "Basal kcal",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric IN ('active_energy','basal_energy_burned')) AS "Total kcal",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='apple_exercise_time') AS "Exercise min" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('active_energy','basal_energy_burned','apple_exercise_time') AND resolution='raw' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Daily energy expenditure and exercise

panels.description: Bars show the hydration buckets received from Apple Health. The dashed yellow line is the 128 fl oz (one US gallon) daily goal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 day',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS time,coalesce(sum(value),0) AS "Recorded water",128.0 AS "1 gallon daily goal" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='dietary_water' AND unit='fl_oz_us' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Water consumption

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone' AS "Start",replace(workout_type,'_',' ') AS "Workout",round((coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM end_time-start_time))/60)::numeric,1) AS "Minutes",round(active_energy_kcal::numeric) AS "Active kcal",round(distance_miles::numeric,2) AS "Miles",round(average_heart_rate_bpm::numeric) AS "Avg HR",round(effort_score::numeric,1) AS "Effort" FROM workouts WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND start_time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND start_time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') ORDER BY start_time;

panels.description: Daily-resolution activity only; known multi-day summary records are excluded.

targets.rawSql: WITH daily AS (SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 day',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS day,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='step_count') AS steps,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='walking_running_distance') AS miles,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='active_energy') AS active_kcal,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='apple_exercise_time') AS exercise FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('step_count','walking_running_distance','active_energy','apple_exercise_time') AND resolution='raw' AND time>=('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz AND time<(('$week 00:00:00 $timezone')::timestamptz+interval '7 days') GROUP BY 1) SELECT day::date AS "Day",round(steps)::bigint AS "Steps",round(miles::numeric,2) AS "Miles",round(active_kcal::numeric) AS "Active kcal",round(exercise::numeric) AS "Exercise min" FROM daily ORDER BY day;
